declarations.name: controlSize
declarations.description:
Structural sizing shared by controls. Every value reads a --heru- token with
a literal fallback equal to the default-density value, so components size
correctly without tokens.css. Density switching via [data-heru-density]
works once tokens.css is loaded (it defines the density-scoped tokens).

declarations.name: controlBox
declarations.default: css` box-sizing: border-box; block-size: var(--_heru-control-height); padding-block: 0; padding-inline: var(--heru-control-padding-inline, 0.75rem); border-width: var(--heru-border-width, 1px); border-style: solid; border-color: transparent; border-radius: var(--heru-radius-5, 5px); `

declarations.name: textRole
declarations.description: Text-role font shorthand. role = label | body | caption

declarations.name: fieldChromeStyles
declarations.default: css` :host { display: block; } :host([hidden]) { display: none; } [part='label'] { display: block; ${textRole('label')} } [part='description'], [part='error'] { ${textRole('caption')} } [part='description'][hidden], [part='error'][hidden] { display: none; } `

declarations.description:
A one-time code input.

One real `<input>` (autocomplete="one-time-code", inputmode="numeric")
drawn as `length` visual boxes. A single input keeps one accessible name,
one tab stop and one value for screen readers, and is what iOS/Android
SMS-code autofill and password managers target; N separate inputs break
autofill, paste and screen-reader reading. The boxes are aria-hidden
decoration; the input sits invisibly on top of them.
declarations.name: HeruOtpInput

declarations.description:
A password input with a show/hide toggle.

The toggle is a real button with a constant accessible name and
`aria-pressed`, so screen readers hear "Show password, toggle button,
pressed/not pressed". Toggling keeps focus, caret and selection in the
input. The value is never reflected to an attribute; spellcheck and
autocapitalize are off so a revealed value isn't sent to spelling
services; the field re-hides on form reset and submit.
declarations.name: HeruPasswordInput

typing isn't drowned in announcements.
